# Role Responsibilities Checklist

This checklist helps ensure each team member understands their role and responsibilities at project start.

## Product Manager Checklist

### Planning Phase
- [ ] Define business goals and success metrics
- [ ] Create initial backlog with priorities
- [ ] Identify target users and personas
- [ ] Align with stakeholders on strategy
- [ ] Establish decision-making authority with team

### Execution Phase
- [ ] Review and approve acceptance criteria
- [ ] Prioritize backlog weekly
- [ ] Participate in planning meetings
- [ ] Review completed work for quality
- [ ] Update stakeholders on progress

### Closing Phase
- [ ] Accept final deliverables
- [ ] Measure success against metrics
- [ ] Plan post-release support and monitoring

---

## Product Owner Checklist

### Planning Phase
- [ ] Understand product strategy and business goals
- [ ] Participate in backlog creation
- [ ] Define clear acceptance criteria for stories
- [ ] Confirm understanding with team on requirements

### Execution Phase
- [ ] Clarify requirements daily with team
- [ ] Answer questions about acceptance criteria
- [ ] Review work in progress
- [ ] Accept or provide feedback on completed items
- [ ] Participate in user acceptance testing (if applicable)

### Closing Phase
- [ ] Final acceptance of all deliverables
- [ ] Confirm readiness for release

---

## Project Manager Checklist

### Planning Phase
- [ ] Schedule and facilitate project kickoff
- [ ] Create project timeline and milestones
- [ ] Identify cross-team dependencies
- [ ] Establish communication cadence
- [ ] Clarify roles and decision authority
- [ ] Set up project tracking tools and templates

### Execution Phase
- [ ] Facilitate daily standups
- [ ] Update project status and timeline weekly
- [ ] Manage risks and escalations
- [ ] Remove blockers and manage dependencies
- [ ] Coordinate cross-team meetings
- [ ] Maintain project documentation

### Closing Phase
- [ ] Plan and lead retrospective
- [ ] Create final project report
- [ ] Archive project artifacts
- [ ] Communicate project completion to stakeholders

---

## Developer Checklist

### Planning Phase
- [ ] Understand product strategy and goals
- [ ] Estimate effort for planned work
- [ ] Identify technical risks and dependencies
- [ ] Participate in defining Definition of Done
- [ ] Review acceptance criteria for clarity

### Execution Phase
- [ ] Implement features to acceptance criteria
- [ ] Write tests for code
- [ ] Participate in code reviews
- [ ] Collaborate with QA on testing
- [ ] Update work status daily
- [ ] Report blockers and risks early

### Closing Phase
- [ ] Complete all planned work
- [ ] Update documentation
- [ ] Prepare for release

---

## QA Lead Checklist

### Planning Phase
- [ ] Understand product goals and success metrics
- [ ] Define quality standards
- [ ] Create test strategy
- [ ] Identify quality-related risks
- [ ] Participate in acceptance criteria review
- [ ] Define Definition of Done from quality perspective

### Execution Phase
- [ ] Review acceptance criteria for testability
- [ ] Create test cases and plans
- [ ] Coordinate testing execution
- [ ] Triage and track defects
- [ ] Work with developers on quality issues
- [ ] Monitor quality metrics

### Closing Phase
- [ ] Complete all testing
- [ ] Approve quality gate for release
- [ ] Plan and execute release testing

---

## Risk Owner Checklist

### Planning Phase
- [ ] Conduct risk identification workshop
- [ ] Document identified risks in Risk Register
- [ ] Assess impact and likelihood
- [ ] Define mitigation strategies
- [ ] Identify risk owners for each risk
- [ ] Establish risk review cadence

### Execution Phase
- [ ] Review Risk Register weekly
- [ ] Monitor mitigation progress
- [ ] Identify new emerging risks
- [ ] Escalate high-priority risks
- [ ] Update risk status and assessments
- [ ] Participate in risk discussions at daily standups

### Closing Phase
- [ ] Close resolved risks
- [ ] Document lessons learned
- [ ] Capture systemic risks for retrospective

---

## Release Manager Checklist

### Planning Phase
- [ ] Understand product goals and release objectives
- [ ] Create release schedule
- [ ] Define release approach (phased/all-at-once)
- [ ] Plan deployment procedure
- [ ] Identify deployment-related risks
- [ ] Define quality gates for release approval

### Execution Phase
- [ ] Coordinate release planning meeting
- [ ] Prepare release notes and documentation
- [ ] Execute pre-deployment checklist
- [ ] Deploy release following procedure
- [ ] Monitor deployment health
- [ ] Execute rollback procedures if needed

### Closing Phase
- [ ] Confirm successful deployment
- [ ] Communicate release completion
- [ ] Monitor post-release stability
- [ ] Document lessons learned

---

## Communications Lead Checklist

### Planning Phase
- [ ] Understand project goals and stakeholders
- [ ] Define communication strategy
- [ ] Create stakeholder communication plan
- [ ] Set up status report templates
- [ ] Establish communication cadence

### Execution Phase
- [ ] Create and distribute weekly status reports
- [ ] Prepare stakeholder briefings
- [ ] Manage project announcements
- [ ] Coordinate incident communications
- [ ] Update project dashboards or channels
- [ ] Ensure consistent messaging

### Closing Phase
- [ ] Prepare project completion announcement
- [ ] Share lessons learned with stakeholders
- [ ] Archive communications for reference

---

## Learning & Improvement Lead Checklist

### Planning Phase
- [ ] Plan retrospective schedule
- [ ] Create retrospective template
- [ ] Establish psychological safety guidelines

### Execution Phase
- [ ] Facilitate sprint/iteration retrospectives
- [ ] Capture lessons learned
- [ ] Document improvement opportunities
- [ ] Track improvement implementation
- [ ] Share learnings with team

### Closing Phase
- [ ] Facilitate project retrospective
- [ ] Finalize lessons learned document
- [ ] Create recommendations for future projects
